dedupe_keys.name: pudl raw eia mecs manufacturing energy consumption survey

description: Catalyst Cooperative archives historical raw inputs for the United States EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey in PUDL Frictionless Data Packages. Zenodo lists nine public survey-year ZIPs from 1991 through 2022 plus datapackage.json. MECS samples manufacturing establishments every four years and reports energy use, spending and related building characteristics. This archive can support consistent multi-year extraction for industrial fuel-mix or electricity-demand scenarios, while the existing catalogue record covers the official EIA survey tables and current source homepage. The PUDL packaging is a separate machine-readable access route. A limitation is that sampling and confidentiality suppression prevent direct plant-level inference; changing survey questions and industry classifications complicate trends. Zenodo labels the materials public domain, but the contents and source-year coverage were not opened individually. No ZIP was downloaded, and no table or expenditure figure was recalculated.
